name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: A light motor vehicle with a seat, two or three wheels and a gas, electric or hybrid motor of 50 cc or its equivalent that can't propel it unassisted past 30 mph; a motorized bicycle operated by its motor past 20 mph is one too. Defined by 18 DCMR 9901.1, as amended by the Motorized Bicycle Amendment Act of 2012 (D.C. Law 19-290).

restrictions.rule: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle, two or three wheels on the ground, an automatic power drive, and a gas, electric or hybrid motor of 50 cc or its equivalent that can't propel it unassisted past 30 mph
A motorized bicycle operated by its motor past 20 mph is a motor-driven cycle
Operated past 30 mph it is a motorcycle, and its rider needs a motorcycle endorsement; riding one faster than 30 mph is a $100 infraction
Rider and passenger must wear a protective helmet; riding without one is a $75 infraction
Carries a passenger only on a seat designed for one
Not ridden on sidewalks; it may be parked on one outside the Central Business District if it doesn't block pedestrians and isn't attached to a tree or planting area
